decisions.story_title: Microsoft expanding Memory Integrity to all Windows operating systems in October 2026
decisions.reason: Real security policy change: Microsoft announced Memory Integrity (VBS/HVCI) will expand to all Windows OS versions in October 2026, hardening against kernel-based exploitation. Notable because it significantly narrows the attack surface for vulnerable driver exploitation.

decisions.story_title: DOT rules allow airlines to skip compensation for cyberattack-caused flight delays
decisions.reason: Regulatory change with real impact: starting next month, airlines can decline meal vouchers and hotel stays when delays are caused by cyberattacks, per new DOT rules. Relevant to incident response and consumer security expectations.

decisions.story_title: Stadtwerke Landsberg KU ransomware attack September 2026
decisions.reason: Real ransomware incident against a German municipal public utility. GDPR Art. 34 notification filed September 7. Relevant as infrastructure-targeting ransomware.

decisions.story_title: Linux kernel ntb DMA memory corruption vulnerability CVE-2026-80884
decisions.reason: Kernel-level memory corruption bug in the NTB DMA subsystem. If unpatched, allows kernel memory corruption via dma_handle manipulation. Relevant to Linux kernel security.
